change: Expand checked GL_TRIANGLE_FAN indices to GL_TRIANGLES on the GL4ES/ANGLE path; retain index identity, winding, last provoking vertex and restart boundaries. No GPU-buffer staging is retained.

component_tests.coverage: Native fan framebuffer equality across 8/16/32-bit indices, reversed winding, degenerates, restart tails and alpha blending; protected stride gaps and native binding restoration; existing original shaders, quads, perspective, sync and context lifecycle. Runner waits for final PASS, not an intermediate draw PASS.

frame_captures.scope: Thirty-second fixed initial observer view of offline Katabatic with two bots. No input, compiler or debugger during recording. Presented Simulator frames, not original FPS counter.

profile.remaining_wait_path: GL4ES immediate render-list flush at BindFramebuffer -> DrawArrays -> ANGLE fan pool. Separate profile after FPS recordings.

controls.spawn: Fire enters Starwolf in offline local match
controls.move: 3-second forward touch changes Starwolf flag distance 39.1 to 21.7
controls.look: Touch drag rotates view from base wall toward hills
controls.weapon: Weapon selects disc launcher with 15 rounds
controls.fire: Touch fire reduces disc ammunition 15 to 14
controls.jet: Held touch raises viewpoint above the base, depletes energy and increases heat; release returns to ground and energy begins recovering

rejected_experiment.description: Transient VBO/EBO staging passed corrected component tests but did not remove the sampled Metal waits; removed before final build.

limitations: Simulator captures are not physical-device performance or a controlled deterministic benchmark.
About 4.9–5.4 presented FPS is still too slow for comfortable play.
Terrain gap, startup latency and prior inventory exit issue remain.
Physical iPad/iPhone execution and HD visual acceptance remain unverified.
